name: Solution Relevance
description: Names the solutions a change, a candidate or a request concerns, best first, so each gets its own consideration; measured as a multi-label classification where a missed solution costs most.
purpose: Name, for any change, candidate or request, the solutions that need their own consideration, so none is skipped.
approach: Rank the records a text matches, carry each match to the solution it belongs to or links to, keep the solutions that score near the best, and add the parent level after them.
out_of_scope: Assembling the prompt for each solution (Solution Consideration does that); ranking records rather than solutions (Spec Search does that); deciding what kind of answer a request wants.
milestones: 1. Solution relevance, free stage: recall of the gold solutions on this repository's mined and hand-labelled cases above the lexical baseline at the same precision floor (metric-solution-relevance). 2. A cheap model classifier arm measured on a staged sample with an approved budget.
measures_of_success: Every gold solution is returned on most cases, with at least a quarter of the returned solutions gold, at no model cost for the free arms.
parameters: limit (how many solutions before their parents, default 5); arm (default: the selected one).
inputs: The specification index of a repository and the text of a change, a candidate or a request.
outputs: Solutions best first, each with a score and the records that reached it; the caller adds the parents.
effects: None; it reads only the index it is given.
usage_notes: `esoi consider TEXT --list` shows the solutions and their parents; the cases come from any repository's history with esoi.understanding.solution_relevance.relevance_cases.mine and its own hand-labelled cases.
